mapper.select:
/* CoioMapper.selectCoioDetailList : 반입/반출(detail) 조회 */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT
COUNT(*) AS TOTAL
od.HBL_NO , od.AR_DATE , od.HSN , od.PIECES , od.PIECES_REAL , od.GWT , od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC , od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC , od.INSPECTION_YN , od.CD_TYPE , od.MRN , (SELECT NAME_KOR FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = od.CD_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE') AS CD_TYPE_NAME , ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN , ad.XRAY_YN , ad.DROP_YN , (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'DROP_CODE' AND CODE = ad.DROP_CODE) AS DROP_REASON , (SELECT TOP 1 MIN(HOLD_RELEASE_YN) OVER(PARTITION BY OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO) AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN , CASE WHEN ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N'), '') IN ('', '4') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_REASON FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N') ELSE (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'HOLD_CODE' AND CODE = (SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N')) END AS HOLD_REASON , CASE WHEN odAdnor.ABNORMAL_CODE = 'MFN' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END mfn , ad.CARRYIN_DATE , ad.CLEARANCE_RECEIPT_DATE , ad.CLEARANCE_DATE AS CLEARANCE_FINISH_DATE , od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_CODE , od.CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_REASON ,( SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(ISNULL(pod.POD_DATE, '1900-01-01'), ' ', ISNULL(pod.POD_TIME, '00:00')) AS POD_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_03 pod WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM251' ) AS CLEARANCE_VIOLATION_DATE , ad.CARRYOUT_DATE
, ad.WH_CARRYOUT_DATE AS RELEASE_DATE , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = ad.CARRYOUT_USER_ID) AS CARRYOUT_USER_ID , (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'WH_LOCATION' AND CODE = ad.WH_LOCATION) AS WH_LOCATION , CONVERT(CHAR(16), ad.STOCK_DATE_TIME, 20) AS STOCK_DATE_TIME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = ad.STOCK_USER_ID) AS STOCK_USER_ID , CONVERT(CHAR(16), ad.DELIVERY_RECV_DATE, 20) as DELIVERY_RECV_DATE ,( SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(ISNULL(pod.POD_DATE, '1900-01-01'), ' ', ISNULL(pod.POD_TIME, '00:00')) AS POD_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 pod WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM361' ) AS PICKUP_DATE , CONVERT(CHAR(16), ad.DELIVERY_DATE, 20) as DELIVERY_DATE ,( SELECT TOP 1 REMARKS FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 pod WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM400' ) AS UNDELIVERY_REASON ,( SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT(ISNULL(pod.POD_DATE, '1900-01-01'), ' ', ISNULL(pod.POD_TIME, '00:00')) AS POD_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 pod WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM400' ) AS UNDELIVERY_DATE , od.MBL_NO , od.VESSEL_FLIGHT , od.ORIG_CODE , od.DEST_CODE , od.CUST_CODE_LV1 AS AGENT_CODE , od.CUST_CODE_LV2 , od.SHIPPER_NAME , od.DELIVERY_NOTE AS DELIVERY_REMARKS , od.OD_JOB_NO , od.ENT_CODE , od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE , od.SOLUTION , od.BOUND , od.BOUND_TYPE , od.PO_NO , od.PO_DATE ,CASE WHEN ad.DROP_YN = 'Y' OR ad.ABNORMAL_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS UNUSUAL , od.REGISTER_USER_ID , od.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , od.UPDATE_USER_ID , od.UPDATE_DATE_TIME ,CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND FUNC_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CB_CODE) AS CB_NAME ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_DELIVERY_CODE' AND CODE = od.DELIVERY_CODE) AS DELIVERY_NAME
,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = ad.LAST_POD_STATUS) AS LAST_POD_STATUS
,ad.LAST_POD_STATUS
, od.BL_TYPE_MH , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N') > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HOLD_YN
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_HP ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
FROM TB_ECM_OD od
WITH (INDEX(TB_ECM_OD_X02))
LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL odAdnor ON od.OD_JOB_NO = odAdnor.OD_JOB_NO
LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_HOLD hld ON hld.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
